initial_teal_design.male:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset: garment-only Alchemist class robe for Questwell.
The input is the approved Scholar robe for this exact body type, on a 240x320 transparent avatar canvas. Use its FIT and CANVAS PLACEMENT as the strict template. Redesign the garment as a distinct Alchemist class coat while keeping the body geometry and position.
CRITICAL COMPOSITION: same 3:4 transparent canvas, same normalized scale and origin. Leave the upper 24% empty for the existing avatar head. Do not zoom or center the coat differently. Neck begins near y76/320, sleeves finish at the existing wrists, long split tails end near y290/320. Keep both sleeve/torso gaps and the full front opening transparent.
Alchemist design: deep petrol TEAL fabric (#0C4A4F), luminous turquoise fold highlights (#2F9B8F), dark-teal inner lining. Fine warm antique-gold piping with restrained pale-green (#B7E86A) embroidery creates continuity with the Questwell class family. A subtle repeated geometric alchemy emblem, a clean circle enclosing a simple upright triangle, is sewn into each shoulder panel; smaller matching symbols near the hems. Neat low-profile cuffs with two narrow gold bands and one slim pale-green inlay. Compact tailored shoulders; fitted lapels; simple slim pocket welts; elegant split coat tails. One tiny pale-green stone in a flat circular setting can sit at each lapel tip, integrated in the fabric. No dangling objects, potions, belts, satchels or accessories. Make precise balanced motifs, not a clutter of pseudo-runes.
Richly shaded high-detail fantasy RPG illustration matching the source, restrained folds, crisp edges, solid opaque sleeves, continuous clean trim. Remove Scholar stars/diamonds/pendants and purple/navy colors; replace them with the Alchemist design described.
OUTPUT ONLY THE COAT. No head, hair, neck, skin, hands, shirt, tie, belt, trousers, shoes, mannequin, text, background, shadow, frame or props. Preserve actual transparent alpha outside garment and inside opening. No detached speckles, holes in sleeves, doubled outlines, floating fragments or scratchy gold lines.
Male fit: keep the original structured shoulder span and arm angle. On the 240x320 coordinate grid neck x108..130 y77; shoulders x81..155 y88; sleeves follow elbows x65/169 y136; cuffs span x62..81 and x156..175, terminating y173; natural waist y151. Tail ends x85/156 near y290. Head space and hands must remain unpainted.

- Main cloth is rich saturated SAPPHIRE BLUE (#1749A0), with deep cobalt shadows (#102B64) and clear luminous BLUE-CYAN highlights (#35BFFF). The fabric must look blue, never green or teal.
- ALL gold/yellow piping, borders, shoulder ornaments, cuffs, pocket welts, gem settings and hem edging become polished cool SILVER (#CCDCEB), with white highlights and blue-grey shadows. Leave no yellow-gold in this garment.
- ALL pale-green embroidery, alchemy circles/triangles, inlays and stones become bright ICE CYAN (#77E8FF). Leave no green gemstones or lime lines.
- Inner lining becomes midnight cobalt blue.
Preserve the crisp tailored fantasy RPG illustration. This is a precise palette edit, not a redesign or reframing. Same 3:4 transparent canvas and exact normalized coat bounds. Preserve all empty head/foot space, front opening and sleeve gaps. Only the coat is present: no body, face, hands, clothes underneath, equipment or background. True transparent alpha.

intermediate_chemistry_design:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Redesign this exact coat into a SCIENCE / CHEMISTRY themed fantasy lab coat for Questwell. The founder wants an obvious chemist, not a wizard. Preserve the fitted body geometry, relaxed arm angles, front opening, compact cuff location, long split-tail length, and transparent canvas placement.
VISUAL HIERARCHY: 65% pearl-white lab-coat cloth, 25% saturated sapphire-blue (#1749A0) lapels, inner lining and side panels, 10% restrained silver/cyan detailing. White sleeves and white front panels must dominate enough to read as a laboratory coat. Cool slate shadows and crisp illustration give the white cloth dimensional volume. Thin ice-cyan piping, narrow silver seams; absolutely no gold, yellow or green.
TAILORING: practical clean notched lab-coat lapels, modest integrated shoulder yoke, fitted waist, slim welt pockets and one small stitched chest patch pocket. Compact sapphire cuffs with a single cyan band. Long elegant split tails retain a little RPG styling but simplify the silhouette and hem trim. Subtle brushed-steel snaps down the open front placket.
SCIENCE IDENTITY: replace every circle/triangle alchemy sigil, rune, diamond, gemstone and jeweled clasp. Use just TWO clear sewn-in science motifs: one small Erlenmeyer-flask outline badge on the chest pocket and one simple six-sided molecular-ring line motif on the opposite upper sleeve. A sparse cyan line of connected hexagonal ring shapes can decorate each lower sapphire side panel. All motifs are simple neat garment embroidery. No words, mathematical text or pseudo-formulas. No floating objects or real accessories. No potions, bottles, tools, goggles, gloves or belt baked in.
FINISH: clean high-detail fantasy RPG illustration matching the richness of the provided robe; coherent cloth folds, smooth opaque sleeve surfaces, crisp outlines and calm, orderly detail. Avoid ornate shoulder armor, capelets, giant epaulettes, brooches and ceremonial decorations. The outfit should look like an adventurous scientist's tailored laboratory coat, not a recolored wizard costume.
Only render the single garment on genuine transparency. Preserve all empty space including the neck opening, sleeves-to-torso gaps and open split front. No person, head, hair, neck, hands, shirt, tie, belt, trousers, footwear, mannequin, background or shadows. Keep the same 3:4 canvas scale and position, do not zoom or crop away empty space.
selection_note: Founder selected the second sapphire-blue design; chemistry details retained. Current three-body app fit awaits visual approval.
